mentions.name: DeepClause
mentions.description: DeepClause is an agentic harness whose core is based on Prolog. Every interaction (conversation turn, planning, plan execution) triggers a small logic program that orchestrates one or more agent loops or prompts. The logic programs are fully hackable, letting users adjust agent core logic and behavior in a reliable manner, and markdown specs can be compiled into Prolog code as an alternative to markdown specs, aiming to unlock spec-driven development. It includes a Prolog/TypeScript integration layer built on SWI Prolog's WASM version, with a deep research example skill demonstrating loop/graph workflows.

mentions.name: DeepClause SDK
mentions.description: This is a Prolog and WASM based LLM/agent framework in which reusable skills and core harness functionality are encoded in a logic programming language. It includes a small TUI with a Borland Turbo Vision style design, and is designed as a completely hackable harness that works well with smaller models, promoting the combination of logic programming and LLMs.
